derivation: Source-derived controls: rewrite only direct FDPC field 0x18/type0x22 with thresholdPoints*12700 using the shared OPL/formatting-page and compound writers. Microsoft Publisher then saves and reopens each candidate. The retained files are native-resaved outputs, not independent native creation.
reproduction: Set every direct FDPC threshold to 0, 8, 12 or 14 points without changing text, page lengths, endpoints or other compound streams; run Invoke-NativePublisherOperation -Operation Validate -Stage Full for each candidate.
observed: All sampled native frame getters report the stored threshold before and after save. With Arial12, threshold0 and14 outputs agree; threshold8 and12 outputs agree; the groups differ in six of15 pages. This qualifies an inclusive size>=threshold activation boundary, with zero disabled.
limits: Rendering controls retain native automatic hyphenation, dictionaries and the observed application profile. Managed rich-text rendering does not yet apply this threshold. Repair-free opening, other producers, inherited style defaults and mixed baselines are not established.
